family: none: smoke test of a pipeline, not a hypothesis test about returns
notes: Outcome: pass. In-sample residual return -0.12% a year (95% interval -0.54% to +0.30%, z -0.57); point-in-time -0.22% a year (-0.63% to +0.19%, z -1.07, n 3959 from 2011-01-03); same-days in-sample -0.09%; gap +0.13% a year (z 1.07); survival ratio 2.457 (shown as 'more than 200% kept'); verdict no_reliable_alpha; in-sample residual volatility 1.21% a year; R2 0.995; quality gate fired (residual_reversal). Rolling one-year band excludes zero in 1.4% of windows; non-overlapping windows 0 of 16 reliable; split halves -0.12% and -0.14% a year (difference p 0.96); diagnostics reject all three tests in both series. AAPL branch skipped: no cached AAPL price file. Descriptive run; not a research claim.
